disposition: Development-only reinterpretation of consumed Ahr and Canadian observations. Protocol fixed before executing this refinement; historical aggregate outcomes were known.

ahr.population: original 199 supported road IDs, 60 proximity candidates, 23 nominal positive-length witnesses
ahr.common_candidate_queue: fixed proximity flag and lexicographic score, identical tie groups

direction.population: 42 previously observed South Saskatchewan blocks; same grid lookup and vector target as pilot
direction.tie: Exact uniform-in-boundary expectation and attainable min/max. No stochastic sample and no interpolation.
direction.agreement_comparator: G ranks complete cases by resultant length of the four unit vectors, then puts incomplete cases in a single lower tie. An agreement-based rejection control, not a reproduction of GFM or trained selective prediction.
direction.conflict_comparator: Only uses a separate pre-release reference; the scoring ADCP vector never enters ranking or policy. None is available, so D equals the observation gate.

states.A: supported nominal model; all required available sensitivity checks agree
states.B: nominal model supported, alternate evidence changes the relationship or leaves robustness indeterminate; disclose which
states.C: missing required evidence for this claim; withhold only the dependent claim
states.D: valid independent observation contradicts the specified target; block its physical escalation
states.E: scale cannot resolve the specified structure; no asset-scale or absence claim
states.F: independent, target-matched support; endpoint and directed traversal separately recorded

arms.D: C plus no independently contradicted same-target release; unresolved reference remains unknown
arms.E: explicit claim scope and typed evidence; report nominal model only if nominal requirements pass, and physical claims only with separately matched independent support
arms.F: abstain on all pathway claims while retaining the candidate queue
arms.G: coverage-constrained directional ensemble concentration control; G unavailable for Ahr path scoring

policies.references: lineage, footprint, time, target, identity and usable support must all pass; contradictions and support may target endpoint or traversal
policies.reliability: no probabilities, performance intervals or external accuracy extrapolation
policies.matched: Subsample within native issue set only. B is infeasible above its issued count; F is feasible at zero only. A/C/D reference-blind uniform ties. E typed ranking for local direction diagnostic only; original road queue rank is preserved.
